scientific_role: structural ecological selector development under ACSP issue 192
global_rule: A structural feature family may be assigned only from taxon-specific habitat evidence frozen before the focal field outcome. Availability of a raster is not evidence that the raster belongs in the selector.

WETLAND_MOISTURE_STRUCTURE.evidence_required: source explicitly identifies wetland, marsh, riparian, saturated or comparable moisture-structured habitat

ALPINE_TOPOGRAPHIC_STRUCTURE.evidence_required: source explicitly identifies alpine/subalpine/high-elevation or mountain-ridge habitat
candidate_structure: snow/exposure proxy only if independently justified
ALPINE_TOPOGRAPHIC_STRUCTURE.forbidden_shortcut: elevation-only nearest-neighbour ranking without spatial comparator

COASTAL_ISLAND_STRUCTURE.evidence_required: source explicitly identifies coastal, maritime, sea-cliff, dune or comparable shore-structured habitat
COASTAL_ISLAND_STRUCTURE.forbidden_shortcut: treating all cells on the same island as one local continuation

candidate_structure: terrain continuity within the substrate component
CALCAREOUS_SUBSTRATE_STRUCTURE.forbidden_shortcut: using broad land-cover similarity as a substitute for substrate

ULTRAMAFIC_SERPENTINE_STRUCTURE.evidence_required: source explicitly identifies serpentine, ultramafic or equivalent substrate
candidate_structure: terrain continuity/barriers within the substrate component
ULTRAMAFIC_SERPENTINE_STRUCTURE.forbidden_shortcut: using generic climate similarity as a substitute for substrate

OPEN_GRASSLAND_STRUCTURE.evidence_required: source explicitly identifies grassland, open meadow or comparable open-habitat structure
OPEN_GRASSLAND_STRUCTURE.forbidden_shortcut: reviving the failed Campanula NDVI-only selector

GENERAL_SPATIAL_BASELINE_ONLY.evidence_required: no source-backed structural habitat family has yet been frozen
candidate_structure: broad robust support for sentinel mode
GENERAL_SPATIAL_BASELINE_ONLY.forbidden_shortcut: adding an ecological feature after seeing the field result

assignment_rule.multi_family_assignment: allowed only when the pre-outcome source explicitly supports multiple structural mechanisms; primary and sensitivity roles must be declared before field outcome

comparison_rule.stable_gain_requirement: Any added-value claim must recur beyond one taxon, one region, and one favorable radius/fraction corner.

claim_boundary: A source-backed structural selector can improve where-search justification; it does not estimate occupancy or prove that the habitat feature causes population occurrence.
